mapper.select: SELECT MATERIAL_CODE, MES_MATERIAL_CODE, SPEC_DESC AS MATERIAL_DESC, SPECIFICATIONS, PRO_SIZE, EMBRYO_CODE, EMBRYO_DESC, PATTERN, HIERARCHY, SPEED_LEVEL AS SPEED, SECTION_WIDTH, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE, BRAND, MES_MATERIAL_CATEGORY, MES_MATERIAL_SUBCATEGORY, MES_MATERIAL_CATE_NAME, MES_MATERIAL_SUBCAT_NAME, SINGLE_TIRE_WEIGHT, DEL_FLAG AS IS_DELETE FROM MES_BAS_MATERIAL WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT STOCK_DATE, MOLD_SLEEVE AS MOULD_SET_CODE, TOTAL_NUM AS TOTAL_QTY, MACHINE_NUM AS MACHINE_QTY, WAREHOUSE_NUM AS ON_HAND_QTY, OUT_NUM AS OUT_BOUND_QTY, PLAN_OUT_NUM AS OUT_BOUND_PLAN_QTY, DOWN_MACHINE_NUM AS DEPLANE_QTY, FORCE_OUT_NUM AS FORCE_OUT_BOUND_QTY, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE, DEL_FLAG AS IS_DELETE FROM MOLD_SHELL_SYNC WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT STOCK_DATE AS OUTBOUND_DATE, MATERIAL_CODE, TYPE_CODE AS MATERIAL_TYPE, MATERIAL_NAME AS MATERIAL_DESC, STOCK_NUM AS OUTBOUND_QTY, UNIT, DATA_VERSION, FACTORY_CODE, DEL_FLAG AS IS_DELETE FROM ORI_MATERIAL_OUT_SYNC WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT t.ONLINE_DATE, t.CX_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.SPEC_DESC, t.EMBRYO_SPEC, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM CX_MACHINE_ONLINE_SYNC t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CX_CODE, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM CX_MACHINE_ONLINE_SYNC WHERE CONVERT(DATE, ONLINE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY CX_CODE ) latest ON t.CX_CODE = latest.CX_CODE AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.ONLINE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT t.ONLINE_DATE, t.LH_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.SPEC_DESC, t.LR_MOLDS, t.IN_MACHINE_MOULD_CODE, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM LH_MACHINE_ONLINE_SYNC t INNER JOIN ( SELECT LH_CODE, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM LH_MACHINE_ONLINE_SYNC WHERE CONVERT(DATE, ONLINE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY LH_CODE ) latest ON t.LH_CODE = latest.LH_CODE AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.ONLINE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT DEV_CODE, PRECISION_TYPE, OPER_TIME, FIRST_WASH_TIME, DEL_FLAG, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM DEV_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion} AND PRECISION_TYPE = #{precisionType}
SELECT OBTAIN_TIME, LH_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, REPLACE_CAPSULE_COUNT, REPLACE_CAPSULE_COUNT2, BRAND FROM LH_REPAIR_CAPSULE WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT LH_CODE, CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(HOUR, 8, OPER_TIME), 120) AS OPER_TIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(HOUR, 8, FIRST_WASH_TIME), 120) AS FIRST_WASH_TIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(HOUR, 8, SECOND_WASH_TIME), 120) AS SECOND_WASH_TIME, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM MOULD_CLEAN_PLAN WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT STRUCTURE_CODE, TREAD_COUNT, DEL_FLAG, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM STRUCTURE_TREAD_CONFIG WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}
SELECT STOCK_DATE, EMBRYO_CODE, STOCK_NUM FROM MES_CX_STOCK WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT t.ORDER_NO, t.SCHEDULE_DATE, t.CX_MACHINE_CODE, t.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS1_UN_REASON, t.CLASS2_UN_REASON, t.CLASS3_UN_REASON, t.CLASS1_PERSON, t.CLASS2_PERSON, t.CLASS3_PERSON, t.EMBRYO_CODE, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_CX_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_CX_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY WHERE CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY SCHEDULE_DATE, CX_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO ) latest ON t.SCHEDULE_DATE = latest.SCHEDULE_DATE AND t.CX_MACHINE_CODE = latest.CX_MACHINE_CODE AND t.ORDER_NO = latest.ORDER_NO AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT t.ORDER_NO, t.SCHEDULE_DATE, t.LH_MACHINE_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS1_UN_REASON, t.CLASS2_UN_REASON, t.CLASS3_UN_REASON, t.CLASS1_PERSON, t.CLASS2_PERSON, t.CLASS3_PERSON,
t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT SCHEDULE_DATE, LH_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY WHERE CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY SCHEDULE_DATE, LH_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO ) latest ON t.SCHEDULE_DATE = latest.SCHEDULE_DATE AND t.LH_MACHINE_CODE = latest.LH_MACHINE_CODE AND t.ORDER_NO = latest.ORDER_NO AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT t.ORDER_NO, t.SCHEDULE_DATE, t.LH_MACHINE_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS1_UN_REASON, t.CLASS2_UN_REASON, t.CLASS3_UN_REASON, t.CLASS1_PERSON, t.CLASS2_PERSON, t.CLASS3_PERSON,
t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT SCHEDULE_DATE, LH_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY WHERE CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE())) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY SCHEDULE_DATE, LH_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO ) latest ON t.SCHEDULE_DATE = latest.SCHEDULE_DATE AND t.LH_MACHINE_CODE = latest.LH_MACHINE_CODE AND t.ORDER_NO = latest.ORDER_NO AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) = CONVERT(DATE, DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE())) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT t.ORDER_NO, t.SCHEDULE_DATE, t.LH_MACHINE_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS1_UN_REASON, t.CLASS2_UN_REASON, t.CLASS3_UN_REASON, t.CLASS1_PERSON, t.CLASS2_PERSON, t.CLASS3_PERSON,
t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY t WHERE t.DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion} AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT FINISH_DATE, DAY_FINISH_QTY, EMBRYO_CODE, EXAMPLE_TYPE, BOM_DATA_VERSION, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_CX_DAY_FINISH_QTY WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT FINISH_DATE, DAY_FINISH_QTY, MATERIAL_CODE, MES_MATERIAL_CODE,
DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_LH_DAY_FINISH_QTY WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion} AND FINISH_DATE = #{queryParams.finishDate}

SELECT LH_BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, SCHEDULE_DATE, LH_MACHINE_CODE, LEFT_RIGHT_MOLD, REMARK, FINISH_STATUS, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM MOLD_ALTER_PLAN_FINISH WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT STOCK_DATE, MATERIAL_CODE, AVAILABLE_STOCK, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_TM_STOCK WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}

SELECT DEV_CODE, PRECISION_TYPE, OPER_TIME, FIRST_WASH_TIME, DEL_FLAG, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM DEV_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WHERE FIRST_WASH_TIME IS NOT NULL AND PRECISION_TYPE = '硫化精度' AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}
SELECT MAX(DATA_VERSION) FROM DEV_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WHERE DATA_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND PRECISION_TYPE = #{precisionType}
SELECT MAX(DATA_VERSION) FROM MOULD_CLEAN_PLAN WHERE DATA_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode}
SELECT MAX(DATA_VERSION) FROM MES_LH_DAY_FINISH_QTY WHERE DATA_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode}

SELECT t.ONLINE_DATE, t.CX_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.SPEC_DESC, t.EMBRYO_SPEC, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM CX_MACHINE_ONLINE_SYNC t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(DATE, ONLINE_DATE) AS online_day, CX_CODE, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM CX_MACHINE_ONLINE_SYNC WHERE CONVERT(DATE, ONLINE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, ONLINE_DATE), CX_CODE ) latest ON CONVERT(DATE, t.ONLINE_DATE) = latest.online_day AND t.CX_CODE = latest.CX_CODE AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.ONLINE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT t.ONLINE_DATE, t.LH_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.SPEC_DESC, t.LR_MOLDS, t.IN_MACHINE_MOULD_CODE, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM LH_MACHINE_ONLINE_SYNC t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(DATE, ONLINE_DATE) AS online_day, LH_CODE, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM LH_MACHINE_ONLINE_SYNC WHERE CONVERT(DATE, ONLINE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, ONLINE_DATE), LH_CODE ) latest ON CONVERT(DATE, t.ONLINE_DATE) = latest.online_day AND t.LH_CODE = latest.LH_CODE AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.ONLINE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, OBTAIN_TIME, 120) AS OBTAIN_TIME, LH_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, REPLACE_CAPSULE_COUNT, REPLACE_CAPSULE_COUNT2, BRAND, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM LH_REPAIR_CAPSULE t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(DATE, OBTAIN_TIME) AS obtain_day, LH_CODE, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM LH_REPAIR_CAPSULE WHERE CONVERT(DATE, OBTAIN_TIME) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, OBTAIN_TIME), LH_CODE ) latest ON CONVERT(DATE, t.OBTAIN_TIME) = latest.obtain_day AND t.LH_CODE = latest.LH_CODE AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.OBTAIN_TIME) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE())
SELECT STOCK_DATE, EMBRYO_CODE, STOCK_NUM FROM MES_CX_STOCK WHERE CONVERT(DATE, STOCK_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE())

SELECT t.ORDER_NO, t.SCHEDULE_DATE, t.LH_MACHINE_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS1_UN_REASON, t.CLASS2_UN_REASON, t.CLASS3_UN_REASON, t.CLASS1_PERSON, t.CLASS2_PERSON, t.CLASS3_PERSON, t.CLASS1_LH_NO, t.CLASS1_LH_TYPE, t.CLASS2_LH_NO, t.CLASS2_LH_TYPE, t.CLASS3_LH_NO, t.CLASS3_LH_TYPE, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) AS schedule_day, LH_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY WHERE CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE), LH_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO ) latest ON CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) = latest.schedule_day AND t.LH_MACHINE_CODE = latest.LH_MACHINE_CODE AND t.ORDER_NO = latest.ORDER_NO AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT t.FINISH_DATE, t.DAY_FINISH_QTY, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.LH_NO, t.LH_TYPE, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_LH_DAY_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(DATE, FINISH_DATE) AS finish_day, FACTORY_CODE, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_LH_DAY_FINISH_QTY WHERE CONVERT(DATE, FINISH_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, FINISH_DATE), FACTORY_CODE ) latest ON CONVERT(DATE, t.FINISH_DATE) = latest.finish_day AND t.FACTORY_CODE = latest.FACTORY_CODE AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.FINISH_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE())

SELECT t.ORDER_NO, t.SCHEDULE_DATE, t.CX_MACHINE_CODE, t.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS1_UN_REASON, t.CLASS2_UN_REASON, t.CLASS3_UN_REASON, t.CLASS1_PERSON, t.CLASS2_PERSON, t.CLASS3_PERSON, t.EMBRYO_CODE, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_CX_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) AS schedule_day, CX_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_CX_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY WHERE CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE), CX_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO ) latest ON CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) = latest.schedule_day AND t.CX_MACHINE_CODE = latest.CX_MACHINE_CODE AND t.ORDER_NO = latest.ORDER_NO AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT t.FINISH_DATE, t.DAY_FINISH_QTY, t.EMBRYO_CODE, t.EXAMPLE_TYPE, t.BOM_DATA_VERSION, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_CX_DAY_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(DATE, FINISH_DATE) AS finish_day, FACTORY_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE, BOM_DATA_VERSION, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_CX_DAY_FINISH_QTY WHERE CONVERT(DATE, FINISH_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, FINISH_DATE), FACTORY_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE, BOM_DATA_VERSION ) latest ON CONVERT(DATE, t.FINISH_DATE) = latest.finish_day AND t.FACTORY_CODE = latest.FACTORY_CODE AND t.EMBRYO_CODE = latest.EMBRYO_CODE AND t.BOM_DATA_VERSION = latest.BOM_DATA_VERSION AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.FINISH_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE())
SELECT DISTINCT DATA_VERSION FROM MOULD_CLEAN_PLAN WHERE DATA_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} ORDER BY DATA_VERSION ASC
